text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And finally, we add Biko-san's favorite 
things... Alright, it's done.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! "Carrotman Sausage" and "Carrotman 
Salisbury Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There's so many of my favorite foods! I 
can't wait to eat it all~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'm looking forward to tomorrow's 
picnic. All that's left is Akebono-san's 
boxed lunches, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I finally finished the 12th tier~ 
...Looks like it'll still take some time, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan and Biko-chan, you two go 
rest first! I'll go to sleep once I finish 
making this 'Buono 20-Layer Chanko 
Bento'!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero never abandons their friends! If us 
sprinters join forces, we can make the 
bentos way faster, right?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's true. If we divide up the tasks, I 
think we can finish at a reasonable hour 
without affecting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Both of you...! Ehehe, thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Akebono, don't worry about the 
portions— just focus on cooking.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'll adjust the portion sizes while 
plating! And I'll divide up whatever 
doesn't fit into the lunchboxes!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll whip up some buono food!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san, please pass me the ingredients 
Akebono-san asked for, and put the 
portions I've divided into the fridge!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll move swiftly and 
efficiently, just like Speed-Style 
'Carrotman Turbo'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! Drop in the meat, BAM! A heap 
of pepper, WHOOSH! Sprinkle the salt, 
pinch-pinch-pinch♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Packing the bento while wrapping up the 
leftovers... Here you go, Biko-san!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrot Boost, full... throttle! 
Doryaryaryaryaryaaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the picnic.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we grab some lunch soon? 
We walked so much, I'm totally starving~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the two of you, it's been 
powered up even more into the "Buono 
30-Tier Chanko Bento"! Eat as muuuuch as 
you like♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, here is the Carrotman bento you 
requested, Biko-san.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, let's eat! Ready, set—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food♪
